**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 14 (with the supporting definitions and Sections 13.2 and 15.1) already delivers our preferred IP position:

- **14.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right and "No right transfers to Vendor."
- **14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for it, with an express present-tense Vendor assignment, personnel assignments and further-assurances.
- **14.3** — Vendor keeps its pre-existing Vendor Technology (acceptable), but embedded/required Vendor Technology carries the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, modifiable licence in 13.2.
- **14.4** — No joint ownership absent a signed instrument; feedback use is generalized only and we retain unrestricted rights in our own feedback.
- **Definitions check** — "Deliverable" (1.4) excludes only Vendor Technology and unaided know-how; "Vendor Technology" (1.8) expressly excludes Customer Data and pre-Effective-Date Customer IP, so neither definition erodes our ownership. **15.1** blocks model training, resale and data combination without our written consent.
